questions.q: According to IUPAC system, the compound  is named as:
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The structure of the IUPAC compound is

Secondary prefix+ primary prefix + root word + Primary suffix + Secondary suffix

It is a cyclic compound, with one OH group on position 1 and double bond at position 2.

There is no secondary prefix in the above compound. primary prefix is cyclo. Root word is hex, primary suffix is en and secondary suffix is ol.

Hence, the name is Cyclohex-2-en-1-ol.

In acyclic compound torsional, steric and Van der wall's strains are present

questions.solution:

A bond dipole moment is a measure of the polarity of a chemical bond between two atoms in a molecule. It involves the concept of electric dipole moment, which is a measure of the separation of negative and positive charges in a system.

questions.q: Appearance of blood red colour, on treatment of the sodium fusion extract of an organic compound with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>FeSO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> in presence of concentrated <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi>SO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> indicates the presence of element/s
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The sodium fusion test, or Lassaigne's test, is used in elemental analysis for the qualitative determination of the presence of foreign elements, namely halogens, nitrogen, and sulphur, in an organic compound.

In Lassaigne's test, if both N and S are present in the organic compound, they are converted to NaSCN.

If SCN- is added to a solution with iron(III) ions, a blood-red solution forms mainly due to the formation of [Fe(SCN)(H2O)5]2+

questions.q: In Dumas method for the estimation of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>, the sample is heated with copper oxide and the gas evolved is passed over:
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
In Dumas method, the nitrogen-containing organic compound, when heated with copper oxide in an atmosphere of carbon dioxide, yields free nitrogen in addition to carbon dioxide and water.

Traces of nitrogen oxides formed, if any, are reduced to nitrogen by passing the gaseous mixture over a heated copper gauze. The mixture of gases so produced is collected over an aqueous solution of potassium hydroxide which absorbs carbon dioxide

So, the correct answer is Copper gauze.

questions.solution:
Partition chromatography is based on continuous differential partitioning of components of a mixture between stationary and mobile phases. Paper chromatography is a type of partition chromatography. In paper chromatography, a special quality paper known as chromatography paper is used. Chromatography paper contains water trapped in it, which acts as the stationary phase.

The relative partition of each component of the mixture is expressed in terms of its retardation factor i.e. Rf value

Rf = distance travel by the solute from the base line distance travel by the solvent from the base line
